name: Alexandria
priorBlocker: The public city-specific search found no verified parcel polygons for Alexandria; ESA map products and NUCA land-offer maps do not establish an open general cadastre for this city.

nativeLanguageSearches.exactQuery: الإسكندرية قطع الأراضي خريطة مساحية بيانات عقارية بوابة حكومية GIS
nativeLanguageSearches.summary: Found an official ESA Alexandria digital-map project and an apparent Alexandria parcel FeatureServer. Inspecting the service metadata extent shows it is in the United States (around longitude −77, latitude 39), not Alexandria, Egypt; rejected as a name collision.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA), with Alexandria Governorate
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official ESA says it and Alexandria Governorate agreed to create digital GIS maps at 1:1,000 and 1:5,000 scales for governorate planning, urban-boundary work and state-property inventory. The page establishes map production but does not identify parcel-cadastre semantics or publish a feature endpoint.
Digital maps require written request specifying location, scale, layers and format, followed by estimate/payment and delivery; no anonymous export is described.

Polygon layer name and fields resemble a parcel layer, but REST metadata extent is EPSG:3857 X −8,587,667..−8,575,751, Y 4,691,628..4,699,487 (roughly Alexandria, Virginia, USA). This is unrelated to the target Alexandria in Egypt; no feature query was made.

Official description of the National Urban Real-Estate Register confirms a property GIS initiative but names Cairo districts rather than Alexandria in its implementation list; it does not establish Alexandria parcel access.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Official project description only; digital map creation for Alexandria Governorate, no online vector endpoint.
Formal-request map access workflow; no anonymous bounded parcel query.
Polygon layer extent is in the Alexandria, Virginia area. Rejected as a geographic name collision without querying features.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Target city only; national or administrative service descriptions do not establish city parcel coverage.

blocker: The official ESA confirms detailed Alexandria digital GIS map production, but its published access route is formal request and purchase. The seemingly relevant ArcGIS parcel service is outside Egypt.
remainingUncertainty: The ESA may hold full city parcel data; public access, terms and an exact target-city feature endpoint remain unverified.
nextStep: Ask ESA/Alexandria Governorate for a small licensed/open GIS extract or public service; do not use the US Alexandria layer.
